note: Crash ledger: one row per runtime fault, joined to docs/equiv_verdicts.json for the function's match status. Regenerate docs/crashes.md with `python3 tools/crashes.py --write`.

crashes.where: FaceGen vtable slot (+0xbc) reached on the character-creation screen
crashes.cause: the `// @ 0x4ea8e0` annotation had drifted off the definition (globals inserted between), so resolve_map had no address->symbol row; the relinker trapped every reference
crashes.fix: annotation restored above `void CamView::update_model`; 31 further annotations still map to nothing (audit)

crashes.where: in-game character sheet via the shared update slot
crashes.cause: the sheet object was dispatched through the FaceGen-only path; +0x310 (b_next_hair) holds a screen float, not a widget pointer
crashes.fix: identity gate (this == the object FaceGen::init ran on) + `is_ui_obj()` on every widget deref

crashes.where: first frame after the menu state machine ran
crashes.symptom: read fault at 0, `vec_back(this)` on an empty widget vector (begin=0, end=4)
crashes.cause: the 23 record tables were declared with 7 slots; the unpatched table's slot 7/8 returned garbage where the original's always1 returns 1, so nothing pushed a root widget
crashes.fix: 9 slots declared on all 23 record tables + build.py redirects suspect matches to the glue copy regardless of length

crashes.cause: btn_text's buf is clobbered during init (a float written over it); the dtor then frees the float. Not a double destroy (verified from the epilogues)
crashes.fix: diagnostic guard in ~tstring (logs tstr_bad.txt, skips the free); the clobbering call is still open

crashes.where: clicking a save slot in Restore a Saved Game
crashes.cause: SavePanel::update passed `char pathbuf[16]`; save_path reads it as a C string and writes the whole "<profile>\\Mount&Blade Savegames\\<prefix>" path back into it (>0x40 bytes), overrunning the neighbouring name[0x200]
crashes.fix: pathbuf is char[0x200]; save_path validates the pointer and zero-initialises dir when SHGetFolderPathA fails

crashes.where: Game::build_map_trees during the loading panel of a new game
crashes.cause: the neighbour lists carry -1; the reconstruction indexed f14 + cur*0x88 and f24 + v*0x24 without a bound test. NOTE: this function's equivalence verdict is FAIL - it is a known divergence
crashes.fix: cur < 0 -> return, v < 0 -> skip, next < 0 -> return

crashes.where: during my own instrumentation of the push probe
crashes.cause: the probe clobbered eax (the `x` argument) with its inline-asm return-address capture - a harness bug, not the game's
